verdict.rationale: Gusto ships its own official remote MCP server, which lets users reach their Gusto data in natural language from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and others, with OAuth and scoped access. It also ships an agent-friendly CLI with bundled skills (payroll-prep, timesheet-sync, cash-forecasting) that supports running per-cycle payroll prep in a single chat session with an agent, gated by human confirmation for writes. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can carry out end-to-end actions such as submitting or running payroll (the CLI only drafts payroll, and the MCP server is described as data access), and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Gusto MCP server allows you to access your data housed within Gusto using natural language within a variety of AI platforms, such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
Agent-friendly developer interface for Gusto payroll. From curl | sh to running per-cycle payroll prep in a single chat session with an agent.
payroll-prep (maps an owner's per-cycle inputs onto a draft payroll for review)
